meta.title: What you'll get up to
meta.intro: From the top of a climbing wall to the middle of a wood at midnight, here's a taste of the adventures on offer at 7th Swindon. Every young person tries things they never expected to.

activities.title: Camps and sleepovers
activities.blurb: Nights under canvas, campfire songs and the pride of a first night away from home.

activities.title: Hikes and navigation
activities.blurb: Map, compass and big skies, finding the way across the countryside as a team.

activities.title: Climbing and heights
activities.blurb: Harness on, nerves aside, climbing, abseiling and conquering the wobble at the top.

activities.title: On the water
activities.blurb: Kayaking, canoeing and paddle-sports, plus the odd deliberate splash.

activities.title: Fire and cooking
activities.blurb: Lighting fires safely and cooking a meal outdoors that somehow always tastes better.

activities.title: Making and creating
activities.blurb: Crafts, building and problem-solving, hands busy, imaginations busier.

activities.title: Science and tech
activities.blurb: Experiments, coding and gadgets, discovering how the world actually works.

activities.title: Skills for life
activities.blurb: First aid, teamwork and confidence, the quiet skills that matter for years.

activities.title: Helping others
activities.blurb: Community projects and good turns that make a real difference close to home.

activities.title: A global family
activities.blurb: Meeting Scouts from around the world and exploring other cultures and causes.
